t: Dulux Easycare Washable & Tough is a water-based matt emulsion paint designed for interior walls and ceilings. This durable paint is ideal for high-traffic areas like busy hallways and kitchens, where spills and scuffs are common. Formulated with advanced stain-repellent technology, it repels spills for effortless cleaning. It is 20x tougher than standard Dulux Matt paint, allowing trade professionals and homeowners to scrub away stubborn marks without damaging the finish. Offering excellent coverage of 13m²/Ltr, it dries in 2 to 4 hours to deliver a clean, pure brilliant white finish.
